text: The Indigenous Affairs Consultant, Data for Equity Unit, People and Equity and the Manager, Data for Equity Unit, People and Equity, will give a presentation on the Data for Equity Strategy, including an update on the creation of the First Nation, Inuit and Métis Data Research Circle of leaders and persons to support City of Toronto's Divisions in engagement, partnership, and collecting/use of First Nation, Inuit and Métis data.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
